title: Bias of the shifted small bias generator
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne0$. The probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$ obtained by choosing the shifted small bias generator uniformly from its parameter space is biased with parameter $(n-1)/2^\ell$: for every nonzero $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the absolute value of its vector Fourier coefficient is at most $(n-1)/2^\ell$.
